# Privacy policy

**Health Connect View**

Last updated: 2026-11-25

This app shows you the health data already stored on your device by Health Connect. It is a viewer: it reads and it displays. The one exception is an export you start yourself.

## What the app reads, and why

With your permission, the app reads the health and fitness data that Health Connect holds on your device: activity (such as steps, distance, exercise sessions and routes), body measurements, cycle tracking, nutrition and hydration, sleep, mindfulness and vitals (such as heart rate, blood pressure and blood oxygen). It uses this data for one purpose: to show it to you on this device as lists, charts and summaries, and in exports you start yourself. The developer collects none of it: nothing is sent to the developer or anyone else, and nothing is used for advertising or profiling.

## Your data never leaves your device

The app has no internet permission at all. This is not a promise about how we behave — Android itself prevents the app from making any network connection. There is no server to send your data to, and no analytics, tracking or advertising code of any kind.

## Read-only access

Only read permissions are requested, so the app cannot change or delete your health records. You choose which data types to allow, one by one, and nothing is selected by default.

## How long data is kept

The developer collects no data, so it keeps none. Health data is held in memory only while you are looking at it, and the app never writes it to disk on its own. The only exception is an export: when you ask for one, the file is written where you choose in Android's own save dialog, and the app keeps no copy. A report you view or print goes to Android's own print preview straight from memory, and from there only where you send it. Otherwise the app keeps only your display settings. “Export settings” saves them to a file you choose; it contains no health data. Backup and device transfer are disabled, so nothing is copied to the cloud. Your display settings stay on your device until you uninstall the app or clear its storage.

## No sharing

Your health data is never shared with anyone, including the developer. No third-party SDKs receive it. An exported file is yours: where it goes from there is up to you.

## Exercise routes

A route is where you were during a session, the most sensitive data Health Connect holds. The app shows one only when you open that session, and only once you have allowed it, for that route or for all routes. It draws the route without a map and keeps it only while you look at it. A route leaves the app only as a GPX file you export yourself, saved where you choose.

## Deleting your data

There is nothing to ask the developer to delete, because no data about you reaches the developer. To remove what the app keeps, your display settings, clear its storage in Android's settings or uninstall it. The health data itself belongs to Health Connect: you can delete it in Health Connect's settings or in the app that wrote it. This app cannot delete it, since it only reads. You can withdraw the app's access at any time in Health Connect settings. Questions: hcview@steppicrew.de.

## Purchases

Optional paid features are handled entirely by Google Play. The app never sees your payment details, and purchase checks happen through the Play Store app rather than over the network.

## Source and contact

The source code is public, so every claim on this page can be checked. Please report issues through the project's issue tracker on GitHub. Questions can also be sent by email to hcview@steppicrew.de.
